title: No Culture Left Behind: ArtELingo-28, a Benchmark of WikiArt with Captions in 28 Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the variation in affective image captioning and subjective emotion prediction across 28 diverse languages, and utilizing a One-vs-All Zero-Shot cross-lingual transfer setup to demonstrate that model performance aligns with real-world cultural proximity rather than just shared writing systems.

Evaluating the performance degradation of state-of-the-art vision-language models when tested on 25 diverse and low-resource languages in zero-shot and few-shot settings, compared to their performance on high-resource training languages like English, Arabic, and Chinese.
